newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's NRMA posts A$8.8 mln year profit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's NRMA posts A$8.8 mln year profit.

text.p: Unlisted Australian insurance and mortoring group NRMA Ltd said on Friday it posted a group profit after tax, abnormals and unrealised gains for the year to June 30, 1996 of A$8.8 milllion, compared with a loss of A$44.5 million.
It said there was an abnormal loss of A$134.6 million, due primarily to the writeoff of future income tax benefits.
The net profit after unrealised gains but before abnormals was A$143.4 million, up substantially from the previous year, NRMA said.

"While 1995/96 has not always been an easy year, our financial performance is improving and we remain in a strong position to continue to provide excellent service to our members and policy holders," NRMA chief executive Malcolm Jones said.
NRMA reported a net profit after unrealised capital movements of A$85.3 million for the six months to December 31, compared with a loss of A$78.3 million a year ago.
"The company's full potential is unlikely to be reached until 1997/98," he said.
NRMA said its gross written premium for the year rose 16.1 percent to a record A$1.67 billion.
Total revenue, including premium income, investment income and membership subscription fees rose by 40.3 percent to A$2.75 billion.
The total number of NRMA members at June 30 was 1.87 million.
